verdict.rationale: Docs and runtime probes show `turso db create` plus `turso db shell` for instant cloud DB creation, and `turso dev` spinning up a fully keyless local libSQL server with a real SQL roundtrip in seconds — no capacity planning, provisioning API for programmatic per-user/agent DB creation, and self-serve signup-to-production flow are all documented and probe-verified. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) benchmark or user account specifically confirming 'seconds-to-ready' timing for cloud creation beyond docs/probe.
